title: THE SELF-REVIVE SAYS SO AGAIN
why: Found by the overnight regression run. When the self-revive got its injector and gear sounds (v25.40), the note about it was written in front of the callout, which turned the callout into comment text. Getting up on your own has said nothing on screen since. SELF-REVIVE USED, with Back on your feet under it, is back, beside the new sounds.
now: Getting up with the self-revive says SELF-REVIVE USED again, along with the new sounds.

edits.anchor: G.tel.revives++; if(!injFoley('revive')) blip('pick'); try{ sndRevLand(); }catch(_rl){}   // v25.40 (usefoleyd): the injector and the gear say('SELF-REVIVE USED','info',{sub:'Back on your feet.'});   // v22.xx (R51): the caps headline, the rest as the detail
